title: Structurally stable singularities and Lipschitz stable optimal transport metrics for the compressible Euler equations
summary: It is well known that solutions to the compressible Euler equations can develop singularities in finite time. In this paper, we carry out a detailed analysis on behaviors of solutions up to the time of the first singularity for the one-dimensional compressible Euler equations with general smooth initial data. Our main results consist of three parts. First, for an open dense set of $C^3$ initial data, we show that the solution of Euler equations is twice continuously differentiable except at most finitely many points when the first singularity happens, using Thom's Transversality Theorem.…
